hints.title: Distance and Parity Check
hints.text: Compute displacement d = abs(endPos - startPos). If d is greater than k or (k - d) is odd, it is impossible to reach endPos in exactly k steps.

hints.title: Step Decomposition
hints.text: Let right steps be r and left steps be l. We require r + l = k and r - l = d, giving r = (k + d) // 2.

hints.title: Combinations Modulo Prime
hints.text: The answer equals the binomial coefficient C(k, r) modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Combinatorial Step Count Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import math

class Solution:
    def numberOfWays(self, startPos: int, endPos: int, k: int) -> int:
        d = abs(endPos - startPos)
        if d > k or (k - d) % 2 != 0:
            return 0
        MOD = 1_000_000_007
        r = (k + d) // 2
        return math.comb(k, r) % MOD
```

complexity.notes: Parity checks and binomial coefficient computation modulo 10^9 + 7.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all 2^k path branches causes exponential runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Combinatorial formula computes count in O(k) or O(1) without 2D table allocation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that step path count reduces to binomial coefficient with parity check.
